review_reference.note: The user-supplied finding list was reproduced. No stored detailed Claude review record/evidence matching this review ID was found by an unrestricted workspace text search, so omitted Claude-only minor items cannot be asserted from an unavailable source. Additional independently reproduced under-binding defects are included.

findings.finding: Production uses dynamic name construction, dynamic import, globals insertion, and annotation rewriting to pass over-broad static scans, weakening the declared type surface.
findings.correction_scope: Replace evasion constructs with ordinary statically typed imports/field access after correcting the frozen static tests; declare expected_binding as ExpectedEnvironmentBinding directly.

findings.finding: RER-S-003 and RER-S-004 do not enforce their stated semantic obligations.
findings.correction_scope: Replace lexical token checks with AST/reference checks and behaviorally bound fail-on-call instrumentation; permit the legitimate ExpectedEnvironmentBinding value type while prohibiting Binding execution.

findings.finding: Terminal-failure tests generally assert only the returned diagnostic and do not prove zero calls at later stages.
findings.correction_scope: Instrument the applicable next-stage boundaries for every terminal family; expand RER-C-009 to all ordered stages or split it if independent observations require new IDs.

findings.finding: RER-C-021 and RER-I-005 cover only a small subset of the side effects and later responsibilities stated by their Strategy rows.
findings.correction_scope: Split the multi-obligation rows into independently observable IDs and add spies for import/compile/lookup/process/network/clock/write/Marker/Binding/Result Manifest/state/lock/recovery/secret boundaries on success and failure.

findings.finding: Several equality/alternative assertions accept canned or otherwise wrong outcomes.
findings.correction_scope: Use controlled finder sentinels and assert the complete exact success/failure plus consumption; prohibit identical canned results from satisfying comparison tests.

findings.finding: Explicit JSON null is absent for startup, startup.kind, and startup.entry because None is used as the missing-field sentinel.
findings.correction_scope: Use a distinct MISSING sentinel and add explicit null cases; current production happened to return the correct typed failures.

findings.finding: A non-Path public argument raises raw AttributeError.
findings.correction_scope: No correction required for v0.1: the typed public domain is Path. If Human DA wants arbitrary path-like/runtime type defense, that is a new explicit interface decision.

findings.finding: A valid JSON huge integer in an unknown field changes the outcome to MALFORMED_JSON instead of remaining inert.
findings.correction_scope: Ensure valid JSON numbers in ignored fields cannot trigger MALFORMED_JSON or alter precedence; add bounded-resource coverage without redefining valid JSON as malformed.

findings.finding: RER-C-025 does not install the fail-on-call path-operation instrumentation required by its Strategy row.
findings.correction_scope: Fail on canonicalize/existence/Marker/identity/read-write probes against data_root_path and assert zero calls.

findings.finding: RER-I-001 asserts only state_id although its Strategy row requires exact mapping of four upstream values.
findings.correction_scope: Assert complete ExpectedEnvironmentBinding and DataRootLocator values using distinct real-upstream sentinels.

findings.finding: RER-S-001 and RER-S-002 check names but not the closed immutable type shapes and exact annotations/return type stated by the Strategy.
findings.correction_scope: Inspect every public dataclass/enum for locality, exact fields, frozen status and field annotations; inspect exact parameter and return annotations.

findings.finding: pip-audit could not query PyPI because DNS resolution was unavailable.
findings.correction_scope: Re-run pip-audit when network/DNS is available; this does not repair or waive the frozen-gate defects.
